The '''AAT Driver Battle Droid''' was a specialized class of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] designed for operating the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] (AAT) of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The droids were colored with dark green facial and torso markings.

==Characteristics==
[[File:AATDriversRugosa-Ambush.png|thumb|left|200px|Two AAT drivers in their tanks on Rugosa]]
The AAT driver's appearance was similar to their mainline B1 droid counterparts, differentiated by their varied shades of dark green markings. AAT driver battle droids could be considered the Separatist equivalent of the clone [[AT-TE commander]]s, being programmed specifically for operating a specific vehicle.

==History==
{{Quote|Uh, hold it. Hold it. &hellip; I said hold it!|[[224/Legends|224]] to unresponsive AAT drivers|audio=Hold_it-I_said_hold_it.flac|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]], several AAT drivers were deployed under the command of [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM commander]] [[224/Legends|224]]. [[T81 Division|The Separatist forces]] were tasked with eliminating [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] escorts in order to prevent the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from negotiating a treaty with [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. They failed in their mission and several AAT drivers were destroyed by the diminutive Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Master]].
